sourceDocuments.title: Decoherence Dynamics in Superconducting Qubits
sourceDocuments.text: Quantum decoherence in mesoscopic physical systems remains a primary bottleneck for superconducting qubits. Environmental electromagnetic radiation induces non-equilibrium quasiparticles that rapidly degrade the quantum state coherence time.
